meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把之前交流时确定的方案和说法直接找回来
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常和AI助手连续协作,却不时忘记上次聊过的结论
copy.tagline_en: Bring back the solution discussed in a previous session with one question
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with an AI assistant across sessions and forget past conclusions

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以在你过去的会话记录里检索:先返回带 ID 和时间的结果索引,再按需拉取摘要,必要时才回看原始工具输出,以少读无关内容。
howto.when: 当你问的是以前会话里的事,比如「这个问题之前解决过吗」「上次 X 是怎么做的」等,而不是当前对话内容时触发。

say.text: 上次那个登录过期的问题我们是怎么解决的?
say.note: 先搜历史记录,再取相关摘要

say.text: 搜一下这个项目里所有跟认证有关的记录
say.note: 返回带 ID 的索引表

say.text: 把上周的 bugfix 记录列出来
say.note: 按日期和类型筛出观察记录

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can search its claude-mem cross-session memory: it returns an index of results with IDs first, then fetches summaries, and opens raw tool output only when needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about work from previous sessions rather than the current conversation, e.g. "did we already solve this?" or "how did we do X last time?"

say_en.text: How did we fix that auth token expiration issue last time?
say_en.note: Searches history, then fetches the summary

say_en.text: Search this project for everything about authentication
say_en.note: Returns an index table with IDs
Filters observations by date and type
